governing_goal: Prevent repeated user-anchored causal conclusions and explanation-only stopping by making problem evidence, causal modeling, architecture evaluation, bounded intervention selection, execution and V&V one evidence-traced transaction without presuming local, upstream or full-rebuild causality.
incident: Repeated live user corrections showed that policy-level hypothesis-first and root-scope rules did not reliably govern real execution. Repository audit found three structural contributors: controlled finalization trusted a precomputed cognition receipt instead of re-deriving the decision from raw evidence; the legacy root-scope model forced complex/systemic cases into exactly one selected hypothesis; and prior assurance tests could prove component shape without proving an end-to-end user-correction -> evidence -> causal model -> intervention -> V&V path.
review_hardening: terminal repair/no-change must match the admitted intervention candidate
V&V evidence must bind to the exact planned method rather than only an allowed evidence type
architecture/control interventions must pass executable architecture-experience admission including CURRENT_AGENT dogfood and failure/recovery scenario
selected interventions require substantive current-system evidence and cannot be supported only by a user claim such as rebuild everything
external_learning: NASA-style governing requirement to verification/validation traceability
ATAM-style scenario and tradeoff architecture evaluation
SRE-style recurrent incident learning with contributing causes and concrete corrective action
CAST/STAMP-style avoidance of simplistic single-root causal narratives
remaining_scope: Native ChatGPT pre-send complete mediation remains unverified and is not claimed.
Registered child domains remain on owner-native behavior assurance until each independently adopts and verifies Common Behavior 1.4.
Unknown future failure classes remain subject to normal post-promotion observation and recurrence detection; they do not keep this maintenance task open.
next_action: No task-local repair remains. Continue normal production observation; reopen only on new evidence or regression.
